mission.title: Eliminating the friction between prototype design and assembly reality.
paragraphs: Too many hardware schedules slip in the gap between a finished design and a working board — a footprint that doesn't match the part, a BOM line that went obsolete, a vendor queue that puts a ten-board prototype behind a ten-thousand-board order.

Goodtron exists to close that gap. Every build starts with an engineering review of your BOM and design for assembly, runs on our own SMT line in Vista, California, and is coordinated directly with the people placing your parts.
attributes: In-house SMT line in North San Diego County, close to Southern California hardware teams.
Prototype and ECO builds turned in days, not weeks.
Free BOM & DFA pre-checks before parts are bought or boards are built.
Small runs are our core business — never squeezed in around large orders.

leader.heading: Meet the founder
leader.name: Daley Chak
leader.title: Founder & Technical Operations Lead
leader.photoLabel: Photo of Daley Chak coming soon
bio: Daley is a veteran electronics manufacturing specialist whose career spans the global hardware manufacturing hub of Shenzhen, China, through to Southern California's tech ecosystem.

Daley brings deep hands-on expertise in surface-mount technology (SMT), high-speed pick-and-place operation on Yamaha SMT platforms, fine-pitch BGA and 0201 placement, and rigorous assembly quality standards.
Daley partners directly with hardware engineers, robotics developers, and medical device innovators to move designs from schematic to physical assembly without costly revisions.

values.heading: What you can count on.
